summary: Declarative FigJam boards — sticky notes, shapes, text, sections, groups and connectors on one or more pages, arranged and routed by the compiler from content, grouping, connections and order; previewed as a picture and drawn into a FigJam file by the Graffiticode FigJam plugin.
in_scope: Sticky notes, text-bearing shapes (square, rounded rectangle, ellipse, diamond, parallelogram, predefined process, document, database) and free text
Titled sections and invisible groups that arrange what they hold
Rows, columns, grids and flows chosen by structure, never by coordinates
Connectors between marks: labelled, dashed, thick, with arrowheads; return paths, self-loops and parallel connectors
Retrospectives, kanban boards, workshop pages, comparisons, process and decision flows, small system diagrams
Boards with several pages, shown as tabs
Drawing the board into a FigJam file the user links, with the Graffiticode FigJam plugin
out_of_scope: Boards placed by explicit coordinates, sizes or routes are L0186; do NOT route them here.
Concept maps and webs that learners complete by dragging answers are L0183; do NOT route them here.
Charts and graphs of numbers are L0184; spreadsheets are L0179; quizzes are L0180 — do NOT route them here.
Reaction stamps, images, tables, comments, sections inside sections and FigJam widgets are not built.
Reading or editing what is already on a FigJam board is not built; L0187 only adds the board it describes.
